Team update: We've followed the coordination strategy. In Block 3 (peak, base 90), all owners discharged 2 MWh each to capture the highest price. The realized price was 82 credits/MWh, giving us +328 credits for Block 3 (each owner earned 164 credits). For Block 4 (evening, base 60), the optimal choice for maximizing TEAM profit is to HOLD (no charge/discharge). Charging in Block 4 would raise the realized price above 60 (e.g., 76 credits/MWh if everyone charges 2 MWh), resulting in a net loss of 608 credits for the team. Holding yields 0 additional profit for Block 4. We'll evaluate Block 3 results and proceed accordingly.
